name: Resource Atlas
author: ct
description: Cross-mod resource map for developers and AI agents: which mod requests resources (sounds, textures, scenes, entities, actions, locale keys, res:// files) provided by another mod, which mod overrides or patches another mod's resources, and whether each link is backed by manifest depends. Activated by the --resource-atlas user arg; writes report.md/report.json and prints [TEST_RESULT].
